# Model generation profile matrix

This file is generated from the typed registry in `mold-core`. Do not edit it by hand.

Regenerate with `cargo run -p mold-ai-core --bin generate_generation_profiles`. Check drift with the same command plus `--check`. The machine-readable companion is [`generated/generation-profiles-v1.json`](generated/generation-profiles-v1.json).

## Contract semantics

- **Dynamic** accepts any canvas satisfying the listed alignment and bounds; presets are qualified recommendations.
- **Buckets** accepts only the exact listed presets.
- **Source driven** derives its canvas from the source; listed presets are guidance for source fitting.
- Limits in this document are effective Mold admission limits. Provenance records whether their authored source is upstream or Mold policy.
